text:
# Travel and Expense Policy: North America
## Overview
This policy sets out travel expense rules for North America. It applies to all full-time employees and contractors based in North America.
## Lodging
Employees are expected to choose the most economical option that meets business needs. For North America travel, the nightly hotel cap is 150 USD.
## Meals
The daily meal allowance in North America is 40 USD. This policy is reviewed annually by the Finance team.
## Flights
Lodging (hotel) bookings must be made through the corporate travel portal. Employees in North America may book business class only for flights longer than 10 hours.
## Approvals
Receipts must be submitted within 21 days of returning from North America travel. Any trip in North America costing more than 3,000 USD requires director approval. Employees are expected to choose the most economical option that meets business needs.
